en: A-Me good. Good, A-Me. Follow... follow A-Me. Home. A-Me go home.

There's a great cook who works at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town.  I've watched him use a knife when he cooks and just between you and me, I don't think he's always been a cook.  Don't get me wrong... if you still want to learn, he's the best we have.
I confront the ruler on his malicious behavior, upholding my liege's honor at the risk of any future diplomacy.

On the cooked goods front it would appear that we've managed to collect and store away $2092w rainbow fin albacore, out of $2093w requested. Additionally, right now we have in $2098w of $2099w roast raptor and $2101w out of $2103w spotted yellowtail in cold storage.
